# 1 bed apartment for sale

> A superb opportunity to purchase a bright, well-proportioned one-bedroom apartment in the heart of Dublin City Centre. No. 2 Jervis Place is a first-floor residence extending to approximately 39 sq. m. The accommodation is well arranged, with an entrance hallway leading to a separate kitchen and a bright living/dining room.
